thread:
maya: FYI I'm rolling a small refresh of the Hello onboarding to introduce an "auth-bridge" flow for private/Dedicated customers. Goals: prefer OIDC via a short env-profile, include a local stub-idp container for dev, and add a CI smoke job that uses prow secret helper. Need quick copy & CI thumbs.

noah: Love the name "auth-bridge". Will this be additive? I don't want existing API_KEY snippets to vanish overnight.

maya: Additive. Plan: show auth-profile first (recommended), then a collapsed "legacy API_KEY" section below. We'll keep the old snippet for 10 days and include migration notes.

rachel: Can you drop the exact env-profile example you'll include so I can sanity-check clipboard copy?

maya: Sure — short example that will be in the doc code block: 

```
# auth-profile (recommended for Private/Dedicated)
REDWOOD_AUTH_PROFILE=./auth_profile.yaml
REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE=oidc
OIDC_ISSUER=https://idp.example.com
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=hello-auth-bridge
# dev-only flag to enable stub-idp
REDWOOD_DEV_STUB=true
```

maya: The local dev flow will use a small `stub-idp` service in docker-compose.override.yml that returns test codes and a session token so devs can run the tutorial without a real IdP. Security note: "stub-idp is dev-only. Do not use in production."

noah: For CI I'll add `ci/docs_quickstart_auth_bridge.sh` which: 1) brings up compose with stub-idp, 2) seeds test secrets via prow secret helper, 3) runs `tests/quickstart_auth_bridge_smoke.py`. Will also add a lightweight healthcheck hitting `/token-exchange`.

rachel: I'll author the smoke test harness and add a tiny pytest that validates generation + token rotation check. Also will include a local helper script `scripts/dev/seed_auth_bridge_secrets.sh` so contributors can run smoke locally. Please document the one-liner to run locally.

maya: Adding the local run one-liner to the PR description: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build && ./scripts/dev/seed_auth_bridge_secrets.sh && ./scripts/dev/run_quickstart_smoke.sh`

noah: Minor copy nit: call the local container "stub-idp (dev-only)" and avoid terms like "mini-IdP". Add a short callout about storing OIDC client secrets in KMS/HSM for Dedicated customers.

rachel: Also add a short migration quicklist for operators: 1) create OIDC client, 2) add redirect URIs, 3) update REDWOOD_AUTH_PROFILE, 4) move secrets to KMS/HSM, 5) run smoke test and monitor. That will help support.

maya: Will include all that and keep the legacy API_KEY appendix live for 10 days. Opening PR now with the docs + compose override + CI job.

docs-bot: PR opened by maya: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5233 - hello onboarding: auth-bridge (auth_profile) + stub-idp + CI smoke job

ci-bot: Reminder: add the `---ci:auth-bridge-smoke` label so the docs pipeline picks up the job.

noah: I'll review the PR in the morning. If CI is green and wording matches the security callouts, happy to approve.

maya: Thanks all — targeting merge tomorrow 08:30 PT after CI ✅. Ping here for anything urgent.
